text:
Sam: Quick follow-up from today's all-hands sales Q&A. Drop 1-2 bullets about why we won or lost deals this quarter and one clear ask for leadership. Keep it short so we can triage.

Diego: Won: predictable p99 and clear cost math for a merchant payments POC. Lost: competitor had a turnkey signal-routing plugin. Ask: a short decision doc on investing in signal-routing parity.

Avery: Lost a mid-market prospect; their infra team said the Private onboarding felt heavy. Ask: 1-page Private quickstart + one-click installer script.

Priya: Tech win: KV cache + batching reduced token spend in demos (~25% savings). Customers reacted to the numbers. Ask: an official benchmark snippet SEs can paste in PRDs.

Lina: CS note: Console traces and request-level cost breakdowns were a trust driver. Losses tied to missing managed KMS/HSM options. Ask: ETA for KMS integrations?

Jordan: SEs hearing confusion in demos around model variants and fallback behavior. Ask: "Which model to pick" one-pager with three buckets (latency / cost / quality).

Mali: Customer anecdote: health startup selected us after an offline eval where caching cut costs ~30%. They said docs/examples sealed the deal. Ask: prioritize clear caching examples and a short notebook.

Diego: Also seeing procurement friction on reserved contracts (billing cadence). Ask: sales + legal to draft a mid-market-friendly contract template.

Sam: Great list. I will create a triage board tomorrow. Reply +1 to confirm or add a single short item.

Avery: +1. Add: Console onboarding checklist for Private with expected time per step.

Priya: +1  I can draft the benchmark snippet by end of week.

Lina: +1  will post a KMS ETA in #eng-security by EOD Friday.

Jordan: +1  will draft the 3-bucket model guide and post to #eng-ml for review.

ops-bot: Reminder: all-hands follow-up survey going out in 10 minutes.

Sam: Thanks all — I'll ping owners after I make the triage board. If anyone has 1-line customer quotes drop them here so we can cite them in PRDs. :thumbsup:
